essence: The prescribed mantra form varies by nasalization or visarga according to the reading.
The priest must employ the class-marked forms at the end of the mantras.
A range of food and dairy substances are prescribed as offerings.
These substances should be offered in the daily ritual.
Bilva fruit should be used for removing disease and lotus for prosperity.
